body: feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says brown foam came from the fertilizer trial; our cat hid from the water bowl before traffic was turned around.
title: cab note — saturday before sunrise
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the brown foam while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: The better car
body: He offered cash to get the road opened while the rest of us waited. The attendant counted the seats in his car and let him go. By morning our line had been listed as empty, though we had never moved.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
